readings: Total up income `amount` by member (`link_to_member`) and work out each total's share of the sum of all the totals. For those whose share is strictly above the average share, give one row with: their combined amount, their average share, and the average amount by which their share is above the average share. No rounding.
queries:
WITH member_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM income
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
shares AS (
    SELECT total_amount,
           CAST(total_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM member_totals
),
compared AS (
    SELECT total_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
